snippet.title: Inside Pyeongchang ICT Olympics!
snippet.description:
Crazy VR Experience at Pyeongchang ICT Lounge with Non-Summit Friends!

- Visit to Pyeongchang ICT Experience Lounge - 
(feat. Zahid, Niklas, Sujan and Ilya, all from the famous TV program Non-Summit)

2018 Pyeongchang Olympic is now just a few days ahead!
Many people from all over the world has already come to Pyeongchang to witness the Olympic games.
Pyeongchang ICT Experience Lounge has opened right beside the famous Olympic Stadium,
So, S_TRY and Non-Summit friends visited the Lounge.
We really had a lot of hands on experience on the cutting-edge ICT technology!

MSIT (Ministry of Science and ICT) has opened the ICT Experience Lounge to the public so that everyone can enjoy ‘ICT Olympic’ with comfort.
ICT Olympic is one of the five goals (Culture, Economy, Environment, Peace and ICT) of 2018 Pyeongchang Olympic and Paralympic Games.

The hottest ‘must go’ attraction was the Roller Coaster VR. It made us feel like we were spinning a whole 360 degrees! What an amazing technology!

The lounge can be accessed only on a pre-reserved basis until the Olympic Games starts. (To make a reservation, please call 82-33-1670-6123)

S_TRY will continue to strive at our bests to contribute for the success of 2018 Pyeongchang Olympic and Paralympic Games.

snippet.title: 2018 평창올림픽 내셔널하우스 방문기! (레오 with 알베르토 and 럭키)
snippet.description:
얼마 전 성황리에 끝마친 대한민국 최초의 동계올림픽인 2018 평창 동계올림픽·패럴림픽!! 올림픽 기간 동안 각국 관계자들은 과연 어디에서 어떻게 지내고 있었을까요?!

오직 소수의 사람들만 가볼 수 있었던 그곳, 내셔널하우스!
알베르토, 럭키와 함께 S_TRY의 레오가 다녀왔습니다~!
캐나다 하우스는 인터넷에서 사전에 티켓을 구매해야 출입이 가능했었어요.
이태리 하우스는 오직 하우스 관계자 분들만 출입을 할 수 있었습니다.
시내에 있는 체코하우스는 누구나 자유롭게 출입이 가능하였습니다!
이 외에 여러 내셔널 하우스들(독일,스위스,미국,핀란드 등)이 있었지만 아쉽게도 다 가보진 못했어요... ㅠㅠ
‘비정상회담’과 ‘어서와 한국은 처음이지’의 인기 방송인 알베르토와 럭키, 그리고 스포츠크리에이터 레오가 함께한 캐나다, 이탈리아, 체코 내셔널하우스 방문기, 같이 관람하실까요?! LET’S GO ~!!

Leo and Ablerto are in Pyeongchag!

Let’t roll~!

snippet.description:
Visit to Incheon International Airport ICT Olympic Lounge

Non-Summit friends visited ICT Olympic Experience Lounge at Incheon International Airport!

Sujan and Zahid had a chance to experience various ICT attractions at the lounge, including VR Bobsleigh, IOT Ice Hockey and UHD VR Pyeongchang.

The lounge is free to access for anyone who is interested in 2018 Pyeongchang Olympic and Paralympic Games, so please do try it out for yourself!

S_TRY will continue to strive at our bests to contribute for the success of 2018 Pyeongchang Olympic and Paralympic Games.

snippet.title: Inside Pyeongchang ICT Olympics!
snippet.description:
Crazy VR Experience at Pyeongchang ICT Lounge with Non-Summit Friends!

- Visit to Pyeongchang ICT Experience Lounge - 
(feat. Zahid, Niklas, Sujan and Ilya, all from the famous TV program Non-Summit)

2018 Pyeongchang Olympic is now just a few days ahead!
Many people from all over the world has already come to Pyeongchang to witness the Olympic games.
Pyeongchang ICT Experience Lounge has opened right beside the famous Olympic Stadium,
So, S_TRY and Non-Summit friends visited the Lounge.
We really had a lot of hands on experience on the cutting-edge ICT technology!

MSIT (Ministry of Science and ICT) has opened the ICT Experience Lounge to the public so that everyone can enjoy ‘ICT Olympic’ with comfort.
ICT Olympic is one of the five goals (Culture, Economy, Environment, Peace and ICT) of 2018 Pyeongchang Olympic and Paralympic Games.

The hottest ‘must go’ attraction was the Roller Coaster VR. It made us feel like we were spinning a whole 360 degrees! What an amazing technology!

The lounge can be accessed only on a pre-reserved basis until the Olympic Games starts. (To make a reservation, please call 82-33-1670-6123)

S_TRY will continue to strive at our bests to contribute for the success of 2018 Pyeongchang Olympic and Paralympic Games.

GO, TEAM KOREA! WE ARE ROOTING FOR YOU!


평창 동계올림픽 ICT 체험존을 가다~!
(feat. 비정상회담 자히드 수잔 닉 일리야)

이제 정말 몇일 남지 않은 2018 평창동계올림픽!!!! 
전세계 사람들이 지금부터 이미 올림픽을 이슈로 한국에 많이 와있는데요,
개막식이 열리는 올림픽 올림픽 스타디움 바로 옆에 
평창ICT라운지가 생겼다고 하여 바로 저희 S_TRY와 비정상회담 친구들(수잔,자히드,닉,일리야)가 직접 첨단과학기술을 체험하고 왔습니다.

과학기술정보통신부는 평창 동계올림픽 5대 목표(문화,경제,환경,평화,ICT 올림픽) 중 하나인
‘ICT 올림픽’ 을 관람객이 편리하게 즐길 수 있도록 무료 개방하였습니다.

이곳에서 가장 H.O.T한 롤러코스터 VR은 몸이 360도 돌아가는 엄청난 리얼감을 느끼실 수 있으니 꼭 체험하시기 바랍니다.

올림픽 개최 전까지는 100% 사전 예약제(1670-6123)으로 운영된다고 합니다.

저희 S_TRY는 2018 평창동계올림픽과 패럴림픽의 성공적인 개최가 되도록 최선을 다하겠습니다!!

snippet.title: BMW X3 VIP SHOWCASE ‘URBAN MISSION’ 현장에 다녀오다ㅣS_TRY_MOTORSPORTS
snippet.description:
2017.11.24 논현동 SJ쿤스트할레에서 VIP분들 만을 위한 BMW X3 SHOWCASE 행사에 레오도 초대 받아서 다녀왔습니다!! 서울 강남 핫플레이스에 핫한 패피들도 자리를 함께해 현장 분위기가 더 뜨거웠는데요, 남태현의 스페셜한 디제잉과 ‘장기하와 얼굴들’의 공연까지!! 영상 함께 보시죠!! 



BMW hosted a VIP showcase “Urban Mission” at SJ Kunsthalle Nonhyun on November 24th 2017. Our friend Leo also took part of the event. Being held at the hottest spot of Gangnam with most trending celebrities attending the showcase, the mood was breathtaking. Special DJing by Nam Tae-hyun and surprise performance by Kiha & the Faces made the place even more exhilarating.

snippet.title: 한국에서 농구 좀 한다는 사람은 다 모였다 2017 Nike Basketball 3-ON-3 EVENT I S_TRY_BASKETBALL
snippet.description:
나이키 농구와 스트릿 컬쳐를 대변하는 NIKE AIR FORCE 1의 35주년을 
기념하여 열린 3ON3 농구대회 현장에 저희 에스트라이도 함께 했습니다.
크리에이터 '레오' 역시 대회에 참가해 농구실력을 뽐냈습니다.
최근 가장 핫한 힙합과 스트릿컬쳐에 대해 온 몸으로 느낄 수 있는 행사였습니다.
레쓰기릿~!!!!

Sports Creative Group, S_TRY

3 ON 3 basketball tournament was held to celebrate the historic 35th anniversary of NIKE AIR FORCE 1, a shoe that represents NIKE’s basketball and street culture, 
S-TRY took part of the event.
Leo, our sports creator, also joined the competition to show his excellent sports performance.
What a meaningful event to breath and touch the popular street culture and hip-hop soul!

Let’s get it~!!!!

snippet.title: 리복과 카시나의 콜라보 런칭 행사(REEBOK X KASINA EVENT) 90년대 헤리티지 감성을 느껴보자 I S_TRY_EVENT
snippet.description:
S_TRY 스포츠 크리에이터 레오가 초대 받았습니다

리복 '워크아웃' 30주년과 국내최대 스트릿 편집샵 '카시나' 가 
론칭  20주년 기념 콜라보레이션 !!

90년대 감성의 리복 벡터 로고와 함께 카시나가 탄생한 1997년 해를 담아
더욱 의미가 깊었던 것 같네요.

90년대 로고와 디자인으로 복고와 트렌드를 한껏 느낄 수 있었던 행사였습니다.

레쓰기릿~!!

S-Try, Your Sports Creator 

Collaboration that celebrates 30th anniversary of Rebook ‘Workout’ and 20th anniversary of ‘Kasina.’
S-Try also took part of the event, where we paid tribute to the birth year 1997 of ‘Kasina’ with Reebok’s vector logo that embodies the feeling and emotion of 90s.
The event brought us to feel the abundance of 90s’ retro trends with its logo and design.

Let’s get it~!!
